description: The image presents two side-by-side 3D pie charts that compare the proportional distribution of four outcome categories. A shared, partially visible legend at the top identifies three of the categories by color: dark teal corresponds to "Atomic Skill Fail," medium teal to "Correct," and light blue to "Reason Err..." (partially cut off), while a fourth category is represented by a white slice. Each pie chart consists of four slices with numerical percentage labels positioned directly inside them. In the left pie chart, the dark teal slice is the largest at 68.0%, followed by the medium teal slice at 12.0%, the light blue slice at 12.0%, and the white slice at 8.0%. In the right pie chart, the proportions differ, with the medium teal slice being the largest at 55.0%, followed by the light blue slice at 21.0%, the white slice at 14.0%, and the dark teal slice at 10.0%. Both charts utilize a tilted 3D perspective with drop shadows, but neither features exploded or offset slices, and the segments do not appear to be arranged in a strict ascending or descending order of size.
